incidents.objectiveSummary: Establish an outgoing Transit Link to Kestrel, review Survey Telemetry, record risk, and dispatch Expedition Unit Alpha.
successFacts: Outgoing reconnaissance link completed with a recorded Survey risk decision and dispatch.
failureFacts: Routine reconnaissance aborted before Expedition Unit dispatch.

incidents.objectiveSummary: Authenticate a friendly return presenting a damaged Return Credential and keep containment decisions fail-secure.
successFacts: Damaged Return Credential was verified and withheld; containment remained under operator control.
failureFacts: Damaged-credential incident ended without a withheld damaged assessment.
incidents.activationHint: Use Return Control scenario 'damaged' while a Transit Link is open.

incidents.objectiveSummary: Detect an unscheduled incoming Transit Link and expose a spoofed Return Credential challenge.
successFacts: Unscheduled incoming was paired with a spoofed credential Security Alert.
failureFacts: Spoofed incoming incident closed without a spoof Security Alert.
incidents.activationHint: Detect incoming, then verify Return Control scenario 'spoofed'.

incidents.objectiveSummary: Open Aurora Survey Site, deploy the Survey Drone, confront contradictory biology markers, and still record a risk decision.
successFacts: Operator recorded a destination risk decision despite contradictory Survey Drone readings.
failureFacts: Contradictory Survey Telemetry incident ended without a recorded risk decision.
incidents.activationHint: Link to survey_site_aurora and resolve Survey Telemetry.

incidents.objectiveSummary: Handle an injured team member while a cooling-capacity fault pressures facility reserves, then recover.
successFacts: Cooling fault cleared and injured personnel accounted for after the overlapping crisis.
failureFacts: Medical and cooling crisis ended without containment recovery.
incidents.activationHint: Incident activation injures field staff and holds cooling capacity until cleared.
